text: Coffee with Reza. He finally booked Tehran for March 2027, three weeks to see his grandparents. Dreading the 14 hour journey with the twins. His wife Neha is staying behind for work. He asked if I'd water their plants and pick up post while they're gone, leaving March 2nd. Said yes. Should get the twins some colouring books for the plane, they're five and get bored fast.
Esme's driving test is November 12th, second attempt. She's properly nervous after failing on roundabouts last time. Remind me to text her good luck the night before.
Mihai and Catalina invited me to their housewarming on 2 November 2026. New place is in Leyton, ground floor with a garden. Catalina said not to bring anything but she's mad about orchids.
Long call with Ines. Her results day was 8/15 and she got into Edinburgh for medicine! Her mum cried apparently. Moves up in September. Must send her something to celebrate.
Jess's 40th dinner got called off, her dad's back in hospital. Need to check in on her this weekend.
Tadhg back from Lisbon, said the flight home was delayed six hours. Already planning Japan for April 2027 with his girlfriend Rosa.

Sophie auditioning for the Royal Academy on January 9th. Cello. She's been practising five hours a day and barely sleeping. Her brother Alfie says she's a wreck. Their parents are flying back from Spain early to drive her down. Results come out around February 20th. I need to message her the morning of the audition, and maybe drop off some of those flapjacks she likes.
I'm doing the dessert for Anil's dinner party Saturday. He's vegetarian now, no gelatine.
Stefan Andersson aka Steffi, from the five a side lot, passed his theory test yesterday. Practical booked for 12/3.
Neha mentioned her sister Zofia is getting married in Kraków on June 3rd 2027. Whole family flying out. Neha is maid of honour and terrified of the speech.

Catch up with Alessia and Oisín. They're both off to Thailand for a month from December 20th, first big trip as a couple. Oisín hates flying so she's got him a fancy neck pillow. Alessia starts her new job when they're back, early February. Should ask how the trip went in the new year.
Ava's GCSE mocks start next week. She's convinced she'll fail maths. Her mum asked if I could do a bit of tutoring on Thursdays.
Dafydd's leaving do is Friday at the Crown. He's off to Cardiff for a new teaching job.
Don't forget to ring Kofi about his citizenship test, it was on Tuesday and I never asked how it went.
Claire and Andre's anniversary is May 14. Ten years. They're doing a weekend in Paris, kids at Andre's mum's.
Ifeoma said her son Owen passed his driving test first time! She's already worried about insurance costs. Sent congrats via her but should message Owen too.
Bumped into Siobhan Walsh at the station. She's flying to Boston on 10/28 for her cousin's wedding. Long haul, first time leaving the baby.
Rosa's surprise party for Lars is 11/22, his 50th. She wants everyone to chip in for a turntable, he's been dropping hints for months. Keep it quiet around him.

Yosef got his bar exam results. Passed! Celebration drinks on the 30th, I said I'd go. He starts at the firm in Manchester on January 6th 2027 and is already flat hunting up there with his girlfriend Dorota. She's not sure about leaving London. Should get him a decent pen or something for the new job.
Sofia Costa and her husband Mohammed are hosting Diwali dinner, even though neither celebrates, because Anil can't get home this year. Lovely. 7pm on November 8th.
Dorota's dog Bruno had his leg operation on Monday. She's been sleeping on the sofa with him. Remind me to ask how he's healing.
Passport renewal. Needs doing before February 2027 or the Morocco trip is off.
Ali told me his brother Kofi failed his pilot medical. Gutted, it was his whole plan. Ali thinks he'll reapply in spring.
Mohammed and his wife are expecting! Due in April. He was grinning the whole time.

Lunch with Jess and Sophie. Jess is off to Iceland on February 14th 2027 with her partner, booked as a surprise. Sophie's exam results come out March 4th and she's trying not to think about it. Need to send Sophie a message that week.
Esme passed!!! Text from her at 10am, the examiner said her parallel parking was textbook. Getting her a keyring as a joke.

Anil's son is sitting the 11 plus on September 13th. Anil seems more stressed than the boy. They've had a tutor since January. Results due October 15th. His wife Siobhan thinks they've pushed too hard and they've been arguing about it. Anil asked if Ava could chat to the boy since she sat it two years ago.
Book table for Mum's birthday dinner, the 18th, somewhere with gluten free options.
Tadhg's mum passed her citizenship test after three goes. He's taking her out for lunch Sunday.
Mihai flies home to Bucharest tomorrow for his grandad's funeral. He sounded flat on the phone. I should check in on him when he lands.
Catalina says Ines got the part in the school musical, Annie, opening night December 5th. Her little brother Alfie is in the chorus too.
Owen's housewarming is off, landlord pulled out last minute. He's staying at his sister Esme's for now and pretty fed up. Must ring him.
Ifeoma and Kofi are doing a big joint 30th at the Hackney boathouse, July 19th 2027. Save the date came through today.

Lars got back from Norway on Sunday after visiting his dad. Said his dad's not doing great, early dementia. Lars is going back in January for a couple of weeks, maybe longer, and his boss has been decent about it. His partner Rosa might join him for the second week. I should check in with him before he goes, he doesn't really talk about this stuff.
Reza mentioned Ali has his citizenship ceremony on 12/9. Should send Ali a card.

Long chat with Zofia over dinner. She's moving to Toronto in August 2027 with her partner Andre, he's got a transfer through work. She's excited but nervous about leaving her mum. They're having a goodbye party sometime in July. Also she's training for the Berlin marathon, September 26th, her first one. Need to sort a present before she goes, she keeps saying she wants a decent rain jacket.
Claire's daughter got into the Royal Ballet School, starts September. Claire's over the moon.
Stefan is a nightmare to buy for but mentioned he'd love a Lego Millennium Falcon.
Neha's grade 8 piano exam was today. She said it went horribly. Results in about six weeks.
Siobhan's hen do is in Dublin, 3/21 to 3/23. I'm going. Booked flights already.
Aunty Dorota rang. Cousin Rosa's graduation is July 2nd in Leeds and she wants me to drive her up. Said yes.
Sophie and Oisín split up. She's taking it badly. The Rome trip in May is obviously cancelled. Need to take her for a drink soon.
Jess works at Heathrow now, ground crew. Says long haul passengers are the worst.
Ava passed her Grade 5 flute with distinction. Her dad sent a video of her playing at the kitchen table.
Catch up with Alfie. Off to Vietnam for six months from 1 March 2027, quitting the bank job first. His parents are not thrilled. His last day is Feb 20th and there's leaving drinks that night.
Yosef and Sofia are hosting a dinner on Saturday the 7th, said I'd bring wine. Sofia's started doing pottery on Wednesdays and loves it.
Must remember: Dafydd's Welsh exam is 5/19. He's barely revised and keeps joking about it but I can tell he's anxious.
Mohammed's back from Hajj. Said it was exhausting but the best thing he's ever done. His mum went too.
Kofi Brennan from work has an interview for the Lagos role on November 4th, flying out the day before. Wish him luck Monday.
Need to pick up Owen's birthday present by the 12th, he's having a dinner on the 13th. The whisky one.
Andre's flat viewing in Clapham went well, he's putting an offer in. Moving maybe February 2027 if it goes through.
Got the invite to Esme and Tadhg's engagement party. 14 November 2026 at her parents' place. Need to RSVP by the 1st and buy a card.

Anil's mum is having her hip done on 12/1. He's flying back to Delhi on November 28th to be there and staying through Christmas. He's worried about the recovery as she lives alone. I should message him the week of the op, and maybe arrange a call once he's back in January.
Ines got 3 As! Off to Edinburgh.
Dorota's citizenship interview got cancelled again, third time. She's so frustrated.
Gym, then laundry, then call the bank.

Ali, Reza and Mohammed doing a lads trip to Marrakech on April 10th. Ali's organising. Mohammed might drop out because of the baby, due around April 2nd, which is cutting it fine. Ali wants a deposit from everyone by December 1st. Reza's sorting the riad. I'm not going, too close to the Morocco trip with Jess, but I said I'd help Ali plan the itinerary.
Ifeoma's mother is visiting from Lagos for Christmas, first time in five years. Ifeoma's anxious about hosting, the flat's tiny. Remind me to offer our spare airbed.
Claire told me her husband Andre proposed to her in Venice, way back in June 2015. They're going back there for the anniversary.

Mihai's back from Bucharest, the funeral was hard but he's okay. He mentioned his brother Stefan's sitting the bar exam in Romania on 2/14 and the whole family's tense about it. Ask Mihai how it went.
